info.title: Q-ai Quran Read API
info.description: Deterministic, LLM-free canonical Quran lookup (Phase 1). Every response uses the stable envelope {api_version, data, meta}; errors use the Diagnostic body.

200.description: server name and build version in the API envelope; no configuration or corpus data
envelope of ayah views; ETag from (text_hash, corpus_generation)

post.description: Run any registered tool by canonical name (D-16 generic typed-tool route). Dispatches through the shared name-to-tool table the CLI `quran tool` verb uses, so tool identity and `research_checksum` cannot diverge between surfaces. The payload is the registry-produced ToolResult verbatim, with its checksum in both `data.research_checksum` and `meta.research_checksum`.

schema.description: The tool's typed params object (e.g. `{"reference": "2:1"}` for `quran.get_ayah`)

400.description: diagnostic body (unknown tool name or bad params)

post.description: Normalize text through a profile (default latest L3.diacritics) or an explicit rule list; returns derived text with its NormalizationTrace. Same pipeline as the CLI (AC-P2-39).

get.description: Labelled debug view (not the product UI): RTL HTML, no persistence.

post.description: Exact search with no linguistic expansion (L0/L1). Zero-result Persian queries carry a hint warning, never a silent fold. Accept: text/event-stream streams one `hit` event per match plus a terminal `totals` event.

Normalized search by registry profile (default L3.diacritics) or adhoc rules; traces and quotations on every hit. Accept: text/event-stream streams one `hit` event per match plus a terminal `totals` event.
Phrase search (ordered_exact/ordered_near/unordered_near) with slop; spans always satisfy the mode. Accept: text/event-stream streams one `hit` event per match plus a terminal `totals` event.
Space-insensitive skeleton search; every hit carries segmentation and spans_* flags. Accept: text/event-stream streams one `hit` event per match plus a terminal `totals` event.
DFA-bounded regex over indexed fields with rate limits (10/min/principal); terms examined always reported. Accept: text/event-stream streams one `hit` event per match plus a terminal `totals` event.
Bounded neighbors around one node (D-12 read parity with the CLI verb). Truncated expansions stay 200 with truncated:true plus a reason.
